description: Pick up and carry block and living entities

mods.name: CarryOn
mods.description: Pick up and carry tile entities and living entities

releases.notes:
Ever wonder why you can carry a stack of 64 empty chests in your pocket, but you can’t move a filled one with your bare hands? Well, wonder no more!

Carry On is a simple mod that improves game interaction by allowing players to pick up, carry, and place single block Tile Entities (such as Chests, Furnaces, Droppers, and your favorite machines from other Tech Mods) using only their empty hands. No items (or pickaxes) required. States, meta data, inventory and NBT data are retained. It also allows you to carry around smaller mobs!

How it Works:

Shift + Right-Click (with two empty hands) on any Tile Entity or baby animal to lift and carry
Right-Click to place
